rules.statement: A court is not required to give notice of confirmation of a sale held by an auctioneer in pursuance of a hypothecary decree under the provisions of the Mortgage Ordinance, No. 21 of 1927.
rules.supporting_quote: Where property is sold by an auctioneer in pursuance of a hypothecary decree entered under the provisions of the Mortgage Ordinance, No. 21 of 1927, the Court is not bound to give notice of confirmation of sale to the judgment-debtor.

meta.parties: Ramanathan Chettiar v. Kurera Et Al
